ner.label: ORG

data.title: Coraz więcej Niemców sceptycznych w sprawach klimatu. Badacze wskazują trzy przyczyny
data.description: Osoby sceptycznie podchodzące do tematu zmian klimatu to w Niemczech już nie wąska grupa. Badacze wskazują, że następuje szybki wzrost liczby Niemców, którzy wyrażają wątpliwości dotyczące kryzysu klimatycznego i wpływu człowieka na to zjawisko.
data.translatedTitle: More and more Germans are skeptical about climate. Researchers point to three reasons
data.translatedDescription: People who are skeptical about climate change are no longer a small group in Germany. Researchers indicate that there is a rapid increase in the number of Germans who express doubts about the climate crisis and human impact on this phenomenon.

data.title: Willa na szczycie niemieckiego bunkra z czasów wojny. Metamorfoza betonowego kolosa
data.description: Rewitalizacja budynku Hochbunker w Monachium była spektakularna. Pozbawiony niegdyś okien, monolityczny bunkier w centrum miasta mieści teraz biura oraz luksusowe mieszkania. Szczyt budynku zajmuje wielopiętrowy apartament z tarasem na dachu.
data.translatedTitle: A villa on top of a German wartime bunker. Metamorphosis of a concrete colossus
data.translatedDescription: The revitalization of the Hochbunker building in Munich was spectacular. The once windowless, monolithic bunker in the city center now houses offices and luxury apartments. The top of the building is occupied by a multi-story apartment with a roof terrace.

data.title: Sztafeta sprinterek z brązowym medalem. Kolejne krążki Swobody i Skrzyszowskiej
data.description: Polskie sprinterki z czasem 43,15 s. zdobyły brązowy medal w sztafecie 100 m. podczas lekkoatletycznych Mistrzostw Europy w Birmingham.
data.translatedTitle: The sprint relay team won a bronze medal. More albums by Swoboda and Skrzyszowska
data.translatedDescription: Polish sprinters won the bronze medal in the 100 m relay with a time of 43.15 seconds during the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham.

data.title: ME Europy. Maria Żodzik ze srebrnym medalem w skoku wzwyż
data.description: Maria Żodzik zdobyła srebrny medal w skoku wzwyż podczas lekkoatletycznych Mistrzostw Europy w Birmingham.
data.translatedTitle: European Championships. Maria Żodzik with a silver medal in high jump
data.translatedDescription: Maria Żodzik won the silver medal in high jump during the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham.

data.title: Zmarzlik znów bez mistrzostwa Polski. Janowski lepszy o punkt. Dramatyczny finał w Ostrowie Wlkp.
data.description: Bartosz Zmarzlik wygrał w Ostrowie Wlkp. 3. finał Indywidualnych Mistrzostw Polski. Nie wystarczyło to jednak złota, które zgarnął Maciej Janowski.
data.translatedTitle: Zmarzlik is again without the Polish championship. Janowski better by a point. Dramatic finale in Ostrów Wlkp.
data.translatedDescription: Bartosz Zmarzlik won the 3rd final of the Polish Individual Championships in Ostrów Wielkopolski. However, it was not enough for the gold medal, which was won by Maciej Janowski.

data.title: W Tatrach szczyt ruchu turystycznego. Więcej gości niż na sylwestra
data.description: Zakopane przeżywa weekendowe oblężenie. Liczba turystów jest nawet o 18 procent większa niż podczas ostatniego Sylwestra – ocenia Tatrzańska Izba Gospodarcza (TIG). Hotele i pensjonaty są zajęte, tłumy widać też na tatrzańskich szlakach.
data.translatedTitle: The peak of tourist traffic in the Tatra Mountains. More guests than on New Year's Eve
data.translatedDescription: Zakopane is under siege over the weekend. The number of tourists is up to 18 percent higher than last New Year's Eve - estimates the Tatra Chamber of Commerce (TIG). Hotels and guesthouses are fully booked, and crowds can also be seen on the Tatra trails.

data.title: Natalia Bukowiecka wicemistrzynią Europy!
data.description: Natalia Bukowiecka zdobyła srebrny medal na 400 metrów podczas lekkoatletycznych Mistrzostw Europy w Birmingham.
data.translatedTitle: Natalia Bukowiecka is the European vice-champion!
data.translatedDescription: Natalia Bukowiecka won the silver medal in the 400 meters during the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham.

data.title: Sieć KIK zamyka 300 sklepów. To koniec agresywnej ekspansji
data.description: Popularna niemiecka sieć dyskontów tekstylnych KIK zapowiedziała zamknięcie ok. 300 swoich sklepów w Europie. Najwięcej placówek, bo aż 150, przestanie działać w Niemczech. Firma przyznaje, że prowadzona przez nią od lat intensywna ekspansja nie dała oczekiwanych rezultatów.
data.translatedTitle: The KIK chain is closing 300 stores. This is the end of aggressive expansion
data.translatedDescription: The popular German textile discount chain KIK announced the closure of approximately 300 of its stores in Europe. Most branches, as many as 150, will cease to operate in Germany. The company admits that its intensive expansion over the years has not yielded the expected results.

data.title: Napięcie wokół Ceuty. Ponad 100 migrantów zatrzymanych przy granicy
data.description: Marokańska policja zatrzymała co najmniej 111 osób, które w sobotę próbowały przedostać się do Ceuty, hiszpańskiej enklawy w Afryce Płn. W Maroku i Ceucie zaostrzono środki bezpieczeństwa po wpisach w serwisach społecznościowych wzywających migrantów do kolejnego masowego sforsowania granicy.
data.translatedTitle: Tension around Ceuta. Over 100 migrants detained at the border
data.translatedDescription: Moroccan police detained at least 111 people who tried to get to Ceuta, the Spanish enclave in North Africa, on Saturday. Security measures were tightened in Morocco and Ceuta after posts on social media calling on migrants to make another mass crossing of the border.

data.title: 22 sierpnia wchodzi nowe prawo. Koniec pracy bez wizy dla obywateli trzech państw
data.description: 22 sierpnia 2026 roku wejdzie w życie rozporządzenie ograniczające w Polsce ruch bezwizowy dla obywateli Kolumbii, Gruzji i Wenezueli. Ma ono ograniczyć rosnącą skalę nielegalnego pobytu i pracy obywateli wspomnianych państw. Jednak eksperci, z którymi rozmawiał na ten temat serwis Puls HR, wskazują, że nowe przepisy leczą skutki zamiast przyczyn.
data.translatedTitle: The new law enters into force on August 22. No more visa-free work for citizens of three countries
data.translatedDescription: On August 22, 2026, a regulation will enter into force limiting visa-free travel in Poland for citizens of Colombia, Georgia and Venezuela. It is intended to limit the growing scale of illegal stay and work of citizens of the above-mentioned countries. However, experts interviewed by Puls HR on this topic indicate that the new regulations treat the effects instead of the causes.

data.title: Lista ulg i świadczeń na orzeczenie o niepełnosprawności w 3 grupach. Nawet 4353 zł miesięcznie i dodatkowy urlop
data.description: Orzeczenie o niepełnosprawności uprawnia do różnego rodzaju ulg i świadczeń. Należą do nich m.in. zasiłek pielęgnacyjny, karta parkingowa, zniżki na przejazdy komunikacją, ulga rehabilitacyjna czy specjalne warunki zatrudnienia. Zakres uprawnień zależy od stopnia niepełnosprawności.
data.translatedTitle: List of reliefs and benefits for a disability certificate in 3 groups. Up to PLN 4,353 per month and additional leave
data.translatedDescription: A disability certificate entitles you to various types of relief and benefits. These include, among others: care allowance, parking card, public transport discounts, rehabilitation relief and special employment conditions. The scope of rights depends on the degree of disability.

data.title: Polacy uciekają z Wielkiej Brytanii? Energetyczny paraliż Rosji
data.description: Wielka Brytania zmaga się z głębokim redefiniowaniem swojego poziomu życia, architektury politycznej oraz pozycji międzynarodowej. Choć wskaźniki makroekonomiczne wykazują względną stabilizację, a inflacja ulega obniżeniu, zwykli mieszkańcy Wysp doświadczają niespotykanej od lat presji finansowej, wynikającej z drastycznych kosztów mieszkalnictwa oraz przeciążenia kluczowych usług publicznych. O wyzwaniach polityki zagranicznej, kryzysie miejskim, strukturalnych reformach ustrojowych oraz powrotach Polaków do ojczyzny rozmawiamy z Zuzanną Ptaszyńską z Uniwersytetu Warszawskiego.
data.translatedTitle: Poles are fleeing from Great Britain? Russia's energy paralysis
data.translatedDescription: Great Britain is struggling with a profound redefinition of its standard of living, political architecture and international position. Although macroeconomic indicators are showing relative stability and inflation is decreasing, ordinary Islanders are experiencing financial pressure unprecedented in years, resulting from drastic housing costs and the overload of key public services. We talk to Zuzanna Ptaszyńska from the University of Warsaw about the challenges of foreign policy, the urban crisis, structural political reforms and the return of Poles to their homeland.

data.title: Włoski sposób na długowieczność robi furorę. Oto na czym polega passeggiata
data.description: Włosi po raz kolejny udowadniają, że do zachowania dobrego samopoczucia do późnej starości nie jest potrzebna restrykcyjna dieta ani karnet na fitness. Ich sekret na długowieczność kryje się w prostej, zakorzenionej w tradycji praktyce – wieczornym spacerze znanym jako passeggiata.
data.translatedTitle: The Italian method for longevity is causing a sensation. This is what passeggiata is all about
data.translatedDescription: Italians prove once again that to maintain good health into old age, you do not need a restrictive diet or a fitness membership. Their secret to longevity lies in a simple practice rooted in tradition - an evening walk known as passeggiata.

data.title: Wpadka byłego szefa IPN. Prezydent Karol Nawrocki mówił o „obrońcach Monte Cassino”
data.description: Polska obchodzi Święto Wojska Polskiego. Podczas przemówienia przed defiladą głowa państwa mówiła o szacunku należnym bohaterom-zwycięzcom, w tym „wielkim obrońcom Monte Cassino”.
data.translatedTitle: A mistake by the former head of the Institute of National Remembrance. President Karol Nawrocki spoke about the "defenders of Monte Cassino"
data.translatedDescription: Poland celebrates Polish Army Day. During his speech before the parade, the head of state spoke about the respect due to the victorious heroes, including the "great defenders of Monte Cassino".

data.title: Trump chce przejąć cieśninę Ormuz. Iran: Zaakceptujcie porażkę i porzućcie urojenia
data.description: Iran ostro zareagował na słowa Donalda Trumpa, który zapowiedział, że wkrótce ogłosi, iż cieśnina Ormuz jest terytorium.. Teheran uznał tę zapowiedź za „urojenia”. - Ormuz nie da się przejąć wpisem na X - skomentował szef irańskiego MSZ.
data.translatedTitle: Trump wants to take over the Strait of Hormuz. Iran: Accept defeat and abandon delusions
data.translatedDescription: Iran reacted sharply to the words of Donald Trump, who announced that he would soon announce that the Strait of Hormuz is territory. Tehran considered this announcement to be "delusional." - Hormuz cannot be taken over with an X entry - commented the head of the Iranian Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

data.title: Zmarła aktorka i piosenkarka Joanna Rawik
data.description: Zmarła aktorka i piosenkarka Joanna Rawik, znana z wykonań piosenek, takich jak „Po co nam to było”, „Romantyczność” oraz „Nie chodź tą ulicą”. Była znana również jako niezrównana interpretatorka piosenek Edith Piaf. O śmierci artystki poinformowała rodzina.
data.translatedTitle: Actress and singer Joanna Rawik has died
data.translatedDescription: The actress and singer Joanna Rawik, known for her performances of songs such as "Poco namium toli", "Romantyność" and "Don't walk this street", has died. She was also known as an incomparable interpreter of Edith Piaf's songs. The artist's family announced her death.

data.title: Pisarz miał stać za serią zbrodni. Dekonspiracji bał się bardziej od śmierci
data.description: Nożownik, członek faszyzującej bandy, podejrzany o zabójstwa, poszukiwany przez Interpol, a jednocześnie syn arcymistrza szachowego i ceniony pisarz dark fantasy. Takie historie kończą się tylko w Mińsku.
data.translatedTitle: The writer was said to be behind a series of crimes. He feared exposure more than death
data.translatedDescription: A knifeman, a member of a fascist gang, suspected of murder, wanted by Interpol, and at the same time the son of a chess grandmaster and a respected dark fantasy writer. Such stories only end in Minsk.

data.title: PŘEHLEDNĚ: Jak se zhoršuje dostupnost bydlení. Nejvíc zdražily byty v Ostravě
data.description: Nové byty ve všech krajských městech během tří let podražily, někde i o desítky tisíc. Prodejní ceny za metr čtvereční navíc všude rostly rychleji než nájemné. Vychází to z dat projektu Realiťák roku ve spolupráci s CEMAP – cenové mapy a portálu Reality.iDNES.cz za letošní červenec.
data.translatedTitle: CLEARLY: How housing affordability is deteriorating. Apartments in Ostrava rose in price the most
data.translatedDescription: New apartments in all regional cities have gone up in price over the past three years, sometimes by tens of thousands. In addition, selling prices per square meter everywhere grew faster than rents. It is based on data from the Realtor of the Year project in cooperation with CEMAP - price maps and the Reality.iDNES.cz portal for this July.

data.title: Maďarsko láká turisty na víno. U Balatonu představilo okružní jízdu retro autobusem
data.description: Maďarské lázeňské město Balatonfüred vyhledávají jachtaři, turisté a nyní už i milovníci vína. Nová okružní jízda retro autobusem totiž nabízí příležitost ochutnat vína od malých, méně známých producentů.
data.translatedTitle: Hungary attracts tourists for wine. It presented a retro bus tour at Lake Balaton
data.translatedDescription: The Hungarian spa town of Balatonfüred is sought after by yachtsmen, tourists and now even wine lovers. The new retro bus tour offers the opportunity to taste wines from small, lesser-known producers.

data.title: Nehorázně drahý. Londýn opouštějí tisíce právníků a bankéřů, hlásí headhunteři
data.description: V příštích pěti letech se přibližně 90 000 londýnských kancelářských pracovních míst pravděpodobně přesune do jiných částí Spojeného království, odhalila nejnovější analýza trhu. Snahy premiéra Andyho Burnhama o decentralizaci spolu s rostoucím tlakem na náklady v hlavním městě motivují podniky ke kroku raději přesunout činnost jinam.
data.translatedTitle: Outrageously expensive. Thousands of lawyers and bankers are leaving London, headhunters report
data.translatedDescription: Around 90,000 London office jobs are likely to move to other parts of the UK in the next five years, the latest market analysis has revealed. Prime Minister Andy Burnham's devolution efforts, along with increasing cost pressures in the capital, are motivating businesses to move elsewhere.

data.title: Koketovala s Rusy. Fotka veselé blondýny připomíná sexuální kolaboraci v srpnu ’68
data.description: Srpnovou invazi drtivá většina československé společnosti přijala s hněvem a odporem. Našly se však i výjimky – a nešlo jen o staré bolševiky. Dokazují to pozapomenuté snímky pořízené západními fotografy před Hlavním nádražím. Příběh naší „horizontální kolaborace“ po srpnu 1968 přináší další díl seriálu Slavné fotografie.
data.translatedTitle: She flirted with the Russians. The photo of the cheerful blonde recalls the sexual collaboration in August ’68
data.translatedDescription: The August invasion was met with anger and resistance by the overwhelming majority of Czechoslovak society. However, there were exceptions - and it was not only the old Bolsheviks. This is proven by the forgotten pictures taken by Western photographers in front of the Central Station. The story of our "horizontal collaboration" after August 1968 brings another part of the series Famous photographs.

data.title: Ozbrojení učitelé a útočné drony. Amerika vymýšlí, jak se bránit školním střelcům
data.description: Ameriku při začátku školního roku válcuje mimořádná debata – řada škol na Floridě, v Georgii a Coloradu zkouší proti násilným střelcům řešení, které by ještě před několika lety působilo jako sci-fi. Chtějí zasahovat vlastními drony.
data.translatedTitle: Armed teachers and attack drones. America is figuring out how to defend itself against school shooters
data.translatedDescription: At the beginning of the school year, America is in an extraordinary debate - a number of schools in Florida, Georgia and Colorado are trying solutions against violent shooters that would have seemed like science fiction just a few years ago. They want to intervene with their own drones.

data.title: Platební karta je jako pas, hotovost už je jen rezerva, říká ředitelka Komerční banky
data.description: Proč je dnes při cestě do zahraničí platební karta v podstatě nutností? Jitka Haubová, provozní ředitelka Komerční banky, popisuje, proč jsou elektronické formy platebních karet bezpečnější. Už proto, že pokusů o zneužití nejenom platebních karet razantně přibývá. Banky tudíž ve velkém investují do umělé inteligence, kterou využívají k odhalování podvodů i k zastavování podezřelých transakcí.
data.translatedTitle: A payment card is like a passport, cash is just a reserve, says the director of Komerční banka
data.translatedDescription: Why is a payment card essentially a necessity when traveling abroad today? Jitka Haubová, operations director of Komerční banka, describes why electronic forms of payment cards are more secure. Already because attempts to abuse not only payment cards are increasing dramatically. Banks are therefore investing heavily in artificial intelligence, which they use to detect fraud and stop suspicious transactions.

data.title: Belgie evakuuje vesnice kvůli rekordním požárům. Německo začíná plameny krotit
data.description: Belgie nadále bojuje s jedním s největších požárů ve svých dějinách, Evropská unie plánuje na pomoc s hašením vyslat tři vrtulníky a dvě letadla. Německým hasičům se naopak daří získávat kontrolu nad plameny, které zachvátily už stovky hektarů lesa u obce Hürtgenwald ve spolkové zemi Severní Porýní-Vestfálsko. Obě země v posledních dnech sužuje vlna veder.
data.translatedTitle: Belgium evacuates villages due to record fires Germany begins to tame the flames
data.translatedDescription: As Belgium continues to battle one of the biggest fires in its history, the European Union plans to send three helicopters and two planes to help with the fight. German firefighters, on the other hand, are managing to gain control over the flames, which have already engulfed hundreds of hectares of forest near the village of Hürtgenwald in the state of North Rhine-Westphalia. Both countries have been plagued by a heat wave in recent days.

data.title: Další pokus o průnik do Ceuty. Na severu Maroka složky zadržely desítky migrantů
data.description: Bezpečnostní složky v sobotu na severu Maroka poblíž hranic se španělskou exklávou Ceutou zadržely několik dalších desítek migrantů. Z Maroka do Ceuty před dvěma týdny ilegálně vnikly desítky tisíc lidí a na internetu se pak objevily výzvy k další takové akci plánované právě na dnešní den.
data.translatedTitle: Another attempt to break into Ceuta. In the north of Morocco, the forces detained dozens of migrants
data.translatedDescription: Security forces detained several dozen more migrants on Saturday in the north of Morocco near the border with the Spanish exclave of Ceuta. Tens of thousands of people entered Ceuta illegally from Morocco two weeks ago, and calls for another such event planned for today appeared on the Internet.

data.title: Melancholik Svoboda. Úspěšnou kariéru zastínila smrt milované ženy i dcery
data.description: Hudebního skladatele Karla Svobodu můžeme bez obav označit za největšího tvůrce hitů české popmusic. Snad každý, kdo v ní od 60. let něco znamenal, za to vděčí alespoň částečně jemu. Měl v sobě něco z italské školy, emotivnost, přiměřený sentiment i nepřemrštěnou hudební zdobnost. Největší inspirací mu byl jeho život, který byl doslova vydlážděn pohnutými momenty. Tím nejfatálnějším byla smrt malé dcery Kláry.
data.translatedTitle: Melancholic Freedom. A successful career was overshadowed by the death of his beloved wife and daughter
data.translatedDescription: Music composer Karel Svoboda can be described without hesitation as the greatest creator of Czech pop music hits. Perhaps everyone who has meant something in it since the 1960s owes at least part of it to him. He had something of the Italian school in him, emotionality, adequate sentiment and not exaggerated musical decorum. His greatest inspiration was his life, which was literally paved with moving moments. The most fatal was the death of the little daughter Klára.

data.title: V Česku padly teplotní rekordy na třetině stanic. Vedra budou pokračovat
data.description: Zhruba 30 procent meteorologických stanic měřicích přes 30 let v sobotu zaznamenaly teplotní rekordy. Nejvíce naměřily v Doksanech na Litoměřicku, teploty se dostaly až na 37,1 stupně. Vedra navíc budou pokračovat i do neděle. Meteorologové očekávají tropy s teplotami mezi 32 až 37 stupni.
data.translatedTitle: In the Czech Republic, temperature records were set at a third of the stations. The heat will continue
data.translatedDescription: About 30 percent of weather stations measuring over 30 years set temperature records on Saturday. They measured the most in Doksany in Litoměřice, temperatures reached 37.1 degrees. In addition, the heat will continue until Sunday. Meteorologists expect the tropics with temperatures between 32 and 37 degrees.

data.title: Riskantní evropská hra s plynem. Co mohou způsobit rekordně nízké zásoby v Unii
data.description: V Bruselu vyvolala ta zpráva významné pozdvižení. Když se 300 metrů dlouhé ruské plavidlo Rudolf Samojlovič, pojmenované podle polárního badatele, vydalo k opravě do suchého doku v moderní dánské loděnici Fayard, nebyla to jen běžná údržba.
data.translatedTitle: Risky European gas game. What record low stocks in the Union can cause
data.translatedDescription: In Brussels, the news caused a significant uproar. When the 300-meter-long Russian vessel Rudolf Samojlovic, named after the polar explorer, went into drydock for repairs at the modern Danish shipyard Fayard, it was not just routine maintenance.

data.title: OBRAZEM: Filipíny se proměnily v „moře odpadků“. Čističi riskovali zdraví
data.description: Záplavy na Filipínách proměnily metropolitní oblast v okolí hlavního města Manily v „moře odpadků“. To zablokovalo vodní kanály a ještě více zhoršilo situaci. Filipínští představitelé hovořili i o „odpadové krizi“.
data.translatedTitle: IN IMAGE: The Philippines has turned into a 'sea of ​​garbage'. The cleaners risked their health
data.translatedDescription: Flooding in the Philippines has turned the metropolitan area around the capital, Manila, into a "sea of ​​garbage". This blocked the water channels and made the situation even worse. Philippine officials also spoke of a "waste crisis".

data.title: Pošli peníze na frontu a vyvázneš. V Rusku se z války stává právní klička
data.description: Ruské soudy stále častěji považují podporu invaze na Ukrajině za důvod k mírnějšímu trestu. Obžalovaní mohou poslat peníze armádě, pomáhat raněným vojákům nebo jezdit s humanitárními konvoji. Z „účinné lítosti“ se tak stává právní strategie, která může trest zmírnit nebo dokonce zcela odstranit.
data.translatedTitle: Send money to the front and you'll be off the hook. In Russia, war becomes a legal loophole
data.translatedDescription: Russian courts are increasingly considering support for the invasion of Ukraine as grounds for a lighter sentence. Defendants can send money to the military, help wounded soldiers, or ride with humanitarian convoys. "Effective remorse" thus becomes a legal strategy that can reduce or even eliminate punishment.

data.title: V brněnských Obřanech požár pohltil šest chat. Hasit pomáhal i vrtulník
data.description: Hasiči v sobotních odpoledních hodinách zasahovali u požáru v Brně, kde jim s hašením pomáhal také policejní vrtulník. Záchranná služba ošetřila chataře se středně těžkými popáleninami a dva zraněné hasiče. Škodu nakonec odborníci vyčíslili na pět miliónů korun, plameny zničily šest chat.
data.translatedTitle: A fire engulfed six cottages in Obřany in Brno. A helicopter also helped to extinguish the fire
data.translatedDescription: On Saturday afternoon, firefighters intervened at a fire in Brno, where a police helicopter also helped them extinguish it. The rescue service treated a cottager with moderate burns and two injured firefighters. In the end, experts calculated the damage at five million crowns, the flames destroyed six cottages.

data.title: Na nejvyšším vrcholu Beskyd na polsko-slovenské hranici zemřel český turista
data.description: Na hoře Babia Góra, která je nejvyšším vrcholem Beskyd, v pátek kvůli zástavě oběhu zemřel 63letý český turista. Horští záchranáři před polednem dostali hlášení, že muž, který se nachází ve vrcholové části hory, má zdravotní potíže.
data.translatedTitle: A Czech tourist died on the highest peak of the Beskydy Mountains on the Polish-Slovak border
data.translatedDescription: A 63-year-old Czech tourist died on Friday due to circulatory arrest on the Babia Góra mountain, which is the highest peak of the Beskydy. Mountain rescuers received a report before noon that a man, who is located at the top of the mountain, has health problems.

data.title: OTÁZKY A ODPOVĚDI: Co se děje okolo heřmanické haldy a jak probíhá sanace
data.description: Vládní koalice bude jednat o statisících tun materiálu, o něž se vedou ostré spory. Heřmanická halda není jen hořící kopec hlušiny po těžbě černého uhlí na okraji Ostravy. Je to jeden z nejzamotanějších sanačních problémů v Česku, ve kterém se potkávají stát, soukromí vlastníci, bývalí majitelé dolů a koksoven, stavební firmy, soudní znalci, úřady a miliardové účty.
data.translatedTitle: QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS: What is happening around the Hermanic heap and how is the remediation proceeding
data.translatedDescription: The government coalition will negotiate hundreds of thousands of tons of hotly contested material. The Heřmanická dump is not just a burning hill of tailings from black coal mining on the outskirts of Ostrava. It is one of the most complicated rehabilitation problems in the Czech Republic, in which the state, private owners, former owners of mines and coking plants, construction companies, forensic experts, authorities and billion-dollar accounts meet.

data.title: O syna pečuje 24 hodin denně, už pětatřicet let. A teď má strach, co bude dál
data.description: Marta pečuje už pětatřicet let o postiženého syna. Asistentů je málo a ona se bojí, co bude dál. „Co si užil ze svobody? Akorát do mekáče si stihl zajít,“ říká o životě svého syna Martina drobná sedmdesátnice Marta. Pečuje o něj už 35 let – od nehody, po níž ještě jako školák zůstal závislý na pomoci druhých.
data.translatedTitle: She has been taking care of her son 24 hours a day, for thirty-five years. And now he is afraid of what will happen next
data.translatedDescription: Marta has been taking care of her disabled son for thirty-five years. There are few assistants and she is afraid of what will happen next. "What did you enjoy out of your freedom? You only managed to go to the mecca," says Marta, a petite woman in her seventies, about her son Martin's life. She has been taking care of him for 35 years - since the accident that left him dependent on the help of others as a schoolboy.

data.title: Nehoda u Ostravy i požár cisterny ve směru na Prahu komplikovaly dopravu na D1
data.description: Od poledních hodin komplikovala provoz na dálnici D1 dopravní nehoda, která se stala zhruba na 350. kilometru u Ostravy směrem na Brno. Na místě se od počátku začala tvořit kolona a místo bylo zcela neprůjezdné. Provoz se podařilo obnovit až po několika hodinách. Komplikace na stejném dálničním tahu způsobil v sobotu ve směru na Prahu také požár cisterny.
data.translatedTitle: An accident near Ostrava and a tanker fire in the direction of Prague complicated traffic on the D1
data.translatedDescription: Since noon, traffic on the D1 highway has been complicated by a traffic accident that happened at approximately the 350th kilometer near Ostrava in the direction of Brno. A column started to form at the place from the beginning and the place was completely impassable. The operation was restored only after several hours. A tank fire also caused complications on the same stretch of highway on Saturday in the direction of Prague.

data.title: Jako vězení. Obyvatele jižního Libanonu sužuje izraelská vojenská přítomnost
data.description: Obyvatelé jižního Libanonu popisují izraelskou vojenskou přítomnost jako „vězení“. Uvádějí, že k práci na svých polích potřebují povolení a že se bojí i vyjít ze svých domovů, protože nevědí, zda tím neporuší některá z izraelských vojenských nařízení. Izraelce obviňují ze zakládání požárů a z nedodržování dohody o rozdělení bezpečnostních zón.
data.translatedTitle: Like a prison. Residents of southern Lebanon are plagued by Israel's military presence
data.translatedDescription: Residents of southern Lebanon describe the Israeli military presence as a "prison". They report that they need a permit to work in their fields and that they are afraid to even leave their homes because they don't know if doing so will violate any of Israel's military regulations. They accuse the Israelis of starting fires and of not complying with the agreement on the division of security zones.

data.title: Tunelem Blanka projíždí nově autobusová linka. Spojí Čimice s Dejvicemi
data.description: Po více než dekádě čekání se cestující o víkendu konečně dočkali tunelbusové linky 145. Autobusy projíždějící tunelem Blanka nyní propojují Dejvice a Sídliště Čimice. Trasa vedoucí přes Hradčanskou a Kobylisy by v dopravní špičce měla trvat zhruba 30 minut.
data.translatedTitle: A new bus line passes through the Blanka tunnel. He will connect Čimice with Dejvice
data.translatedDescription: After more than a decade of waiting, passengers finally got the tunnel bus line 145 at the weekend. Buses passing through the Blanka tunnel now connect Dejvice and Sídliště Čimice. The route leading through Hradčanská and Kobylisy should take approximately 30 minutes during rush hour.

data.title: V létě do školy. Žáci zalévají záhony i sklízí zeleninu, další zahrady jsou ale v ohrožení
data.description: U škol v Česku se čím dál častěji objevují záhony, v nichž roste zelenina i drobné ovoce. O rostliny se starají samy děti, a to i přes prázdniny. Pokud je plodin dost, kuchařky je využívají ve školním roce do obědů a svačin. Peníze na budování nových zahrad ale už budou školy shánět obtížněji.
data.translatedTitle: To school in the summer. Pupils water the flower beds and harvest vegetables, but other gardens are in danger
data.translatedDescription: At schools in the Czech Republic, flower beds in which vegetables and small fruits grow are appearing more and more often. The children take care of the plants themselves, even during the holidays. If there are enough crops, the cooks use them for lunches and snacks during the school year. However, it will be more difficult for schools to find money to build new gardens.

data.title: Babiš a dva ministři vyšli na Lysou horu. Náročnější než loni, hodnotil premiér
data.description: Premiér Andrej Babiš a ministři průmyslu a obchodu Karel Havlíček a práce a sociálních věcí Aleš Juchelka (všichni ANO) v sobotu dopoledne vystoupali na nejvyšší vrchol Moravskoslezských Beskyd, Lysou horu (1323 m n. m.). Společně s nimi vyrazily desítky příznivců a regionálních politiků ANO. Babiš přiznal, že letošní túra mu dala zabrat více než loni.
data.translatedTitle: Babiš and two ministers went up to Lysa hora. More demanding than last year, assessed the Prime Minister
data.translatedDescription: Prime Minister Andrej Babiš and Ministers of Industry and Trade Karel Havlíček and Labor and Social Affairs Aleš Juchelka (all ANO) climbed the highest peak of the Moravian-Silesian Beskydy Mountains, Lysou horu (1323 m above sea level) on Saturday morning. Dozens of ANO supporters and regional politicians set out together with them. Babiš admitted that this year's hike took him longer than last year.

data.title: Akademika z Cambridge, který čelil obvinění z plagiátorství, našli mrtvého
data.description: Britský akademik Jason Arday, jehož jméno se v posledních dnech pojilo s obviněním z plagiátorství a odchodem z profesorského postu na Cambridgeské univerzitě, zemřel. Jeho tělo našli v pátek v Londýně. Ardayovi bylo jednačtyřicet let. Britský premiér Andy Burnham jeho smrt označil za tragédii.
data.translatedTitle: A Cambridge academic who faced accusations of plagiarism has been found dead
data.translatedDescription: British academic Jason Arday, whose name has been linked in recent days to allegations of plagiarism and resignation from his professorship at Cambridge University, has died. His body was found in London on Friday. Arday was forty-one years old. British Prime Minister Andy Burnham described his death as a tragedy.

data.title: Poláci vysvětili nejvyšší sochu Panny Marie v Evropě. Předčila i Krista v Riu
data.description: Obří sochu Panny Marie, kterou v polské vesnici vztyčili na začátku srpna, v sobotu vysvětili. Tyčí se do výšky 55,6 metrů, čímž se zapsala jako nejvyšší svého druhu v Evropě. Její výstavbu zafinancoval jeden z nejbohatších polských podnikatelů.
data.translatedTitle: Poles consecrated the tallest statue of the Virgin Mary in Europe. She also surpassed Christ in Rio
data.translatedDescription: The giant statue of the Virgin Mary, which was erected in the Polish village at the beginning of August, was consecrated on Saturday. It rises to a height of 55.6 meters, making it the tallest of its kind in Europe. Its construction was financed by one of the richest Polish businessmen.

data.title: Sebevražedná úzkost, čekání na návrat. Na palubě vysílené lodi USS Abraham Lincoln
data.description: Námořníci nasazení na americké letadlové lodi USS Abraham Lincoln jsou na své misi už extrémně dlouho. Více než půl roku. A mnozí z nich zoufale čekají na návrat do domovského přístavu. Někteří pomýšlejí i na sebevraždu. Odborníci proto varují, že další prodlužování námořních operací přinese další problémy.
data.translatedTitle: Suicidal anxiety, waiting to return. Aboard the defunct USS Abraham Lincoln
data.translatedDescription: Sailors deployed on the USS Abraham Lincoln have been on their mission for an extremely long time. More than half a year. And many of them are desperately waiting to return to their home port. Some even think about suicide. Experts therefore warn that further prolongation of naval operations will bring more problems.

data.title: Střety se vyhrotily, pomohli spojenci. Jaká by byla válka Československa s Německem
data.description: Československo se po Mnichovské dohodě pustilo do války s Německem. Takový byl sobotní fiktivní scénář letošní bojové ukázky Cihelna v Králíkách. Pohraniční střety mezi československými vojáky a německými ozbrojenými skupinami přerostly v otevřený konflikt, do kterého se zapojili také spojenci, uvedl provozní ředitel Vojenského muzea Králíky Martin Večeř.
data.translatedTitle: Clashes escalated, allies helped. What would a war between Czechoslovakia and Germany be like?
data.translatedDescription: Czechoslovakia went to war with Germany after the Munich Agreement. Such was Saturday's fictitious scenario of this year's combat demonstration Cihelno v Králíky. The border clashes between Czechoslovak soldiers and German armed groups turned into an open conflict, in which the allies also got involved, said Martin Večeř, operational director of the Králíky Military Museum.

data.title: Zemětřesení v Indonésii zabilo přes třicet lidí, úřady varovaly i před tsunami
data.description: Nejméně 38 lidí zemřelo při zemětřesení o síle 7,7, které v noci na sobotu zasáhlo pobřeží indonéského ostrova Flores. Předchozí bilance činila 20 mrtvých. Úřady původně vydaly varování před tsunami, později ho však odvolaly. Tisíce obyvatel pobřežních oblastí byly evakuovány. České ministerstvo zahraničních věcí nemá informace o tom, že by zemětřesení postihlo české občany.
data.translatedTitle: The earthquake in Indonesia killed over thirty people, the authorities also warned of a tsunami
data.translatedDescription: At least 38 people have died after a 7.7 magnitude earthquake hit the coast of the Indonesian island of Flores on Saturday night. The previous toll was 20 dead. Authorities initially issued a tsunami warning, but later withdrew it. Thousands of residents of coastal areas were evacuated. The Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs has no information about the earthquake affecting Czech citizens.

data.title: Auto ukazuje 48 stupňů, ČHMÚ jen 41,5 °C. Expert vysvětluje proč i postupy při měření
data.description: Česko přepisuje teplotní rekordy, displeje aut či teploměry na fasádách ale ukazují ještě vyšší hodnoty. Klimatolog Radim Tolasz pro iDNES.cz vysvětluje, proč se výsledky liší, co všechno musí odborníci prověřit, než mimořádnou hodnotu uznají za nový český rekord, a proč ČHMÚ dál měří i na nestandardních místech, jako je pražské Klementinum.
data.translatedTitle: The car shows 48 degrees, CHMÚ only 41.5 °C. The expert explains why and the measurement procedures
data.translatedDescription: The Czech Republic is breaking temperature records, but car displays and thermometers on facades show even higher values. Climatologist Radim Tolasz explains to iDNES.cz why the results differ, what experts have to check before they recognize the extraordinary value as a new Czech record, and why the ČHMÚ continues to measure at non-standard places, such as Prague's Klementinum.

data.title: Šestnáct evakuovaných a jeden zraněný. Požár pohltil byt v Karviné
data.description: Požár v sobotních brzkých ranních hodinách pohltil jeden z bytů v Karviné. Na místě zasahovali profesionální i dobrovolní hasiči, kteří z bytového domu evakuovali šestnáct obyvatel. Škoda je předběžně stanovená na čtvrt milionu korun, včasný zásah však uchránil majetky násobně vyšší.
data.translatedTitle: Sixteen evacuated and one injured. The fire engulfed the apartment in Karviná
data.translatedDescription: A fire engulfed one of the apartments in Karviná in the early hours of Saturday morning. Professional and volunteer firefighters intervened on the scene and evacuated sixteen residents from the apartment building. The damage is tentatively estimated at a quarter of a million crowns, but early intervention saved many times more property.

data.title: Naše střela Flamingo zasáhla podnik spadající pod Roskosmos, oznámil Zelenskyj
data.description: Ukrajinská střela s plochou dráhou letu Flamingo v sobotu v ruské Samarské oblasti zasáhla podnik Progress, který spadá pod ruskou vesmírnou agenturu Roskosmos. Oznámil to ukrajinský prezident Volodymyr Zelenskyj, podle nějž Progress vyrábí mimo jiné elektroniku. Zasažena byla také letecká základna Savaslejka a ropný terminál Usť-Luga, dodal.
data.translatedTitle: Our Flamingo missile hit an enterprise under Roskosmos, Zelensky announced
data.translatedDescription: On Saturday, a Ukrainian cruise missile Flamingo hit the Progress enterprise, which falls under the Russian space agency Roskosmos, in Russia's Samara region. This was announced by Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyi, according to whom Progress produces, among other things, electronics. The Savaslejka air base and the Usť-Luga oil terminal were also hit, he added.

data.description: Brüsszelből egyre nagyobb nyomás érkezik a bérlakásépítés támogatására. Ez összefügg a migrációval is, hiszen a Magyar Péter által aláírt uniós migrációs paktum végrehajtásához elhelyezési kapacitás kell.

data.translatedDescription: There is increasing pressure from Brussels to support the construction of rental housing. This is also related to migration, since the implementation of the EU migration pact signed by Péter Magyar requires accommodation capacity.

data.description: A híres építészpáros, Komor Marcell és Jakab Dezső különleges alkotása ismét régi fényében ragyog.
data.translatedTitle: A Hungarian Art Nouveau wonder was renovated in Palic in the southern region
data.translatedDescription: The special work of the famous architect couple Komor Marcell and Dezső Jakab shines again in its old glory.

data.description: Az úszóedző szerint a biztos vízbiztonsághoz rendszeres gyakorlás kell, és még a derékig érő vízben is megtörténhet a baj.
data.translatedTitle: Knowing how to swim can save your life
data.translatedDescription: According to the swimming coach, regular practice is necessary to be safe in the water, and trouble can happen even in waist-deep water.

data.description: Tóth Máté szerint a kormányfő a szakmai egyeztetés helyett politikai látványeseményt rendezett, a késlekedés pedig akár 42 milliárd forintba is kerülhetett.
data.translatedTitle: Péter Magyar ran away: Máté Tóth was not allowed to enter Paks
data.translatedDescription: According to Máté Tóth, the prime minister organized a political spectacle instead of a professional consultation, and the delay could have cost up to HUF 42 billion.

data.translatedDescription: The socialist representatives of the town of Albanchez de Mágina in Spain have separated the city's centuries-old celebration from the day of their patron saint.

data.description: O filme "You don't belong here", do realizador romeno Florin Serban, venceu hoje o Leopardo de Ouro, no 79.º Festival de Cinema de Locarno, na Suíça, que também premiou a atriz italiana Monica Bellucci.
data.translatedTitle: Film "You don't belong here", by Florin Serban, won the Golden Leopard at the Locarno Festival
data.translatedDescription: The film "You don't belong here", by Romanian director Florin Serban, won the Golden Leopard today, at the 79th Locarno Film Festival, in Switzerland, which also awarded an award to Italian actress Monica Bellucci.

data.title: Incêndio na Bélgica já consumiu mais de 2.700 hectares de floresta
data.description: As autoridades belgas confirmaram este sábado que a área ardida saltou para 2.700 hectares nas últimas horas, naquele que é já considerado o pior incêndio florestal da história recente do país.
data.translatedTitle: Fire in Belgium has already consumed more than 2,700 hectares of forest
data.translatedDescription: Belgian authorities confirmed this Saturday that the burned area jumped to 2,700 hectares in the last few hours, in what is already considered the worst forest fire in the country's recent history.

data.title: Europeus de Atletismo. Isaac Nader 12.º nos 1.500 metros
data.description: O português Isaac Nader terminou hoje no 12.º lugar a final dos 1.500 metros dos Campeonatos da Europa de atletismo, na cidade inglesa de Birmingham, com o tempo de 03.39,80 mimutos, a 3,99 segundos do vencedor, o neerlandês Stefan Nillessen.
data.translatedTitle: European Athletics Championships. Isaac Nader 12th in the 1,500 meters
data.translatedDescription: Portuguese Isaac Nader finished 12th today in the 1,500 meter final of the European Athletics Championships, in the English city of Birmingham, with a time of 03.39.80 minutes, 3.99 seconds behind the winner, Dutchman Stefan Nillessen.

data.title: Nadadora Kate Douglass fixa recorde mundial dos 50 m livres em 23,49 segundos
data.description: A nadadora norte-americana Kate Douglass bateu hoje o recorde do mundo dos 50 metros livres, fixando-o em 23,49 segundos, durante as eliminatórias dos Campeonatos Pan-Pacíficos, em Irvine, nos Estados Unidos.
data.translatedTitle: Swimmer Kate Douglass sets world record for the 50m freestyle in 23.49 seconds
data.translatedDescription: American swimmer Kate Douglass broke the world record for the 50 meter freestyle today, setting it at 23.49 seconds, during the qualifiers for the Pan-Pacific Championships, in Irvine, in the United States.

data.title: II Liga. Torreense em inferioridade numérica resgata empate na compensação
data.description: O Torreense e o Penafiel empataram hoje 2-2, em encontro da segunda ronda da II Liga de futebol, com o detentor da Taça de Portugal a conseguir o empate aos 90+3 minutos, já reduzido a 10 elementos.
data.translatedTitle: II League. Torreense in numerical inferiority rescues draw in compensation
data.translatedDescription: Torreense and Penafiel drew 2-2 today, in a match in the second round of the II Football League, with the Portuguese Cup holder achieving the equalizer in the 90+3 minutes, already reduced to 10 players.

data.title: Europeus de atletismo. Jéssica Barreira termina heptatlo no 12.º lugar
data.description: Jéssica Barreira conseguiu hoje a melhor classificação de sempre de uma portuguesa no heptatlo em Campeonatos da Europa de atletismo, ao terminar no 12.º lugar, após ter sido 21.ª nos 800 metros.
data.translatedTitle: European athletics. Jéssica Barreira finishes heptathlon in 12th place
data.translatedDescription: Jéssica Barreira achieved today the best classification ever by a Portuguese woman in the heptathlon at the European Athletics Championships, finishing in 12th place, after being 21st in the 800 meters.

data.title: Pichardo conquista prata nos Europeus de Atletismo em Birmingham
data.description: O português Pedro Pablo Pichardo voltou hoje a conquistar a medalha de prata do triplo salto nos Campeonatos da Europa de atletismo Birmingham2026, com 17,76 metros, a 39 centímetros do italiano Andy Díaz.
data.translatedTitle: Pichardo wins silver at the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham
data.translatedDescription: Portuguese Pedro Pablo Pichardo won the silver medal in the triple jump at the Birmingham2026 European Athletics Championships today, with 17.76 meters, 39 centimeters behind the Italian Andy Díaz.

data.description: Um veículo florestal de combate a incêndios de Vinhais ardeu no incêndio do concelho.

data.translatedDescription: A forestry firefighting vehicle from Vinhais burned in the municipality's fire.

data.translatedDescription: Frenchman Alexis Guerin won a stage again in this Tour of Portugal.

data.description: O Ministério da Administração Interna confirmou este sábado a morte de um cidadão na sequência de um acidente que envolveu uma viatura dos Bombeiros de Amarante.
data.translatedTitle: Celorico de Basto. Accident with fire engine leaves one dead
data.translatedDescription: The Ministry of Internal Administration confirmed this Saturday the death of a citizen following an accident involving an Amarante Fire Brigade vehicle.

data.title: Excesso de mortalidade. Mais 680 óbitos do meio de junho ao fim de julho
data.description: Morreram em Portugal mais 680 pessoas do que era esperado entre junho e julho.

data.translatedDescription: 680 more people died in Portugal than expected between June and July.

data.title: Há menos turistas a visitar o Algarve em agosto
data.description: A descida para já é pequena, mas o aumento dos preços está claramente a afastar portugueses da região algarvia este verão.
data.translatedTitle: There are fewer tourists visiting the Algarve in August
data.translatedDescription: The drop is small for now, but the rise in prices is clearly keeping the Portuguese away from the Algarve region this summer.

data.title: Incêndio na Bélgica já é o maior na história do país
data.description: Um grande incêndio na Bélgica obrigou à retirada dos moradores e turistas. O fogo está ativo há cerca de 24 horas e é já o maior na história do país.
data.translatedTitle: Fire in Belgium is already the biggest in the country's history
data.translatedDescription: A huge fire in Belgium forced the evacuation of residents and tourists. The fire has been active for around 24 hours and is already the largest in the country's history.

data.title: Tráfico de cocaína. Península Ibérica é a principal porta de entrada
data.description: A Península Ibérica volta a ser a principal porta de entrada de cocaína na Europa.
data.translatedTitle: Cocaine trafficking. Iberian Peninsula is the main gateway
data.translatedDescription: The Iberian Peninsula is once again the main gateway for cocaine into Europe.

data.title: Família quer guarda das crianças. Requerimento para o tribunal está a ser preparado
data.description: A família do jovem que matou a mãe em Algés vai pedir a guarda da rapaz e da irmã de 4 anos.
data.translatedTitle: Family wants custody of children. Application to the court is being prepared
data.translatedDescription: The family of the young man who killed his mother in Algés will ask for custody of the boy and his 4-year-old sister.

data.title: Acidente na Volta a Portugal. "Toda a organização está muito abatida"
data.description: O dia de sábado na Volta ficou marcado por várias homenagens ao jovem ciclista que morreu na sexta-feira.

data.translatedDescription: Saturday's day at the Tour was marked by several tributes to the young cyclist who died on Friday.

data.title: I Liga. Rio Ave - FC Porto
data.description: O FC Porto foi hoje a casa do Rio Ave somar mais três pontos, com dois golos sem resposta a valerem a vitória no jogo da segunda jornada da I Liga de futebol nacional.
data.translatedTitle: I League. Rio Ave - FC Porto
data.translatedDescription: FC Porto went to Rio Ave's home today to add three more points, with two unanswered goals earning them victory in the second round game of the I National Football League.

data.title: Diogo Ribeiro na final dos 50 metros livres, Camila Rebelo oitava nos 100 costas
data.description: O nadador português Diogo Ribeiro apurou-se hoje para a final da prova dos 50 metros livres dos Europeus de desportos aquáticos de 2026, enquanto Camila Rebelo foi oitava na final dos 100 costas em Paris.
data.translatedTitle: Diogo Ribeiro in the 50 meter freestyle final, Camila Rebelo eighth in the 100 backstroke
data.translatedDescription: Portuguese swimmer Diogo Ribeiro qualified today for the final of the 50 meter freestyle event at the 2026 European Aquatics Championships, while Camila Rebelo was eighth in the final of the 100 backstroke in Paris.

data.title: Seleção feminina de basquetebol perde segundo jogo de preparação com Turquia
data.description: A seleção portuguesa feminina de basquetebol voltou a perder hoje frente à congénere turca, por 56-44, depois da derrota na véspera (63-51), em jogos de preparação para a segunda ronda de qualificação para o EuroBasket feminino 2027.
data.translatedTitle: Women's basketball team loses second preparation game against Türkiye
data.translatedDescription: The Portuguese women's basketball team lost again today to its Turkish counterpart, 56-44, after the defeat the day before (63-51), in preparation games for the second round of qualification for the women's EuroBasket 2027.

data.title: Félix da Costa no pódio em Londres critica “estratégias feias” da Porsche
data.description: O piloto português António Félix da Costa (Jaguar) terminou hoje no terceiro lugar a penúltima corrida do Mundial de Fórmula E, em Londres, ficando arredado da luta pelo título.
data.translatedTitle: Félix da Costa on the podium in London criticizes Porsche’s “ugly strategies”
data.translatedDescription: Portuguese driver António Félix da Costa (Jaguar) finished third today in the penultimate race of the Formula E World Championship, in London, leaving him out of the fight for the title.

data.title: II Liga: Sporting B vence Desportivo de Chaves com golo ‘solitário` de Atanásio Cunha
data.description: O Sporting B somou hoje a segunda vitória noutras tantas jornadas da II Liga portuguesa de futebol, após bater o Desportivo de Chaves (1-0), em Alcochete, com um golo 'solitário' de Atanásio Cunha.
data.translatedTitle: II Liga: Sporting B beats Desportivo de Chaves with a ‘lonely’ goal from Atanásio Cunha
data.translatedDescription: Sporting B scored their second victory today in as many rounds of the II Portuguese Football League, after beating Desportivo de Chaves (1-0), in Alcochete, with a 'lone' goal from Atanásio Cunha.

data.title: Marrocos ordena expulsão de jornalistas espanhóis que cobriam crise migratória em Ceuta
data.description: Um representante do Ministério marroquino do Interior ordenou este sábado a saída das equipas da agência de notícias EFE e da televisão pública espanhola TVE de Fnideq, Castillejos, onde se encontravam a fazer a cobertura da situação junto à fronteira de Ceuta.
data.translatedTitle: Morocco orders expulsion of Spanish journalists who covered the migration crisis in Ceuta
data.translatedDescription: A representative of the Moroccan Ministry of the Interior ordered the departure of teams from the EFE news agency and Spanish public television TVE this Saturday from Fnideq, Castillejos, where they were covering the situation near the Ceuta border.

data.description: O avançado português Gonçalo Ramos contribuiu hoje com um golo para a vitória por 4-2 do AC Milan sobre o Manchester United, em jogo particular de futebol, que marcou o reencontro do treinador Ruben Amorim com a equipa inglesa.
data.translatedTitle: AC Milan vence no reencontro de Ruben Amorim com o Manchester United
data.translatedDescription: Portuguese striker Gonçalo Ramos contributed a goal today to Milan's 4-2 victory over Manchester United, in a football friendly, which marked coach Ruben Amorim's reunion with the English team.

data.title: Duplas de vela portuguesas brilham e sobem a quarto e quinto nos Mundiais de 470
data.description: Os velejadores portugueses Beatriz Gago e Rodolfo Pires subiram hoje ao quarto lugar e os olímpicos Diogo Costa e Carolina João alcançaram o quinto nos mundiais da classe 470, no Japão.
data.translatedTitle: Portuguese sailing pairs shine and rise to fourth and fifth in the 470 World Championship
data.translatedDescription: Portuguese sailors Beatriz Gago and Rodolfo Pires climbed to fourth place today and Olympians Diogo Costa and Carolina João reached fifth in the 470 class world championship, in Japan.

data.title: Guérin vence na Senhora da Graça e encaminha-se para o triunfo final
data.description: O ciclista francês Alexis Guérin (Anicolor-Campicarn) encaminhou-se hoje para a vitória na Volta a Portugal, ao triunfar isolado na chegada ao alto da Senhora da Graça, em Mondim de Basto, numa enlutada nona e penúltima etapa.
data.translatedTitle: Guérin wins at Senhora da Graça and heads towards final triumph
data.translatedDescription: French cyclist Alexis Guérin (Anicolor-Campicarn) continued to victory today in the Tour of Portugal, triumphing alone on arrival at the top of Senhora da Graça, in Mondim de Basto, in a grieving ninth and penultimate stage.

data.title: I Liga. Académico Viseu - Santa Clara
data.description: O Académico de Viseu perdeu hoje contra o Santa Clara (0-1), em jogo a contar para a segunda jornada da I Liga de futebol nacional, após golo solitário de Gonçalo Paciência. A equipa açoriana com esta vitória junta-se provisoriamente ao Sporting no topo da I Liga.
data.translatedTitle: I League. Academic Viseu - Santa Clara
data.translatedDescription: Académico de Viseu lost today to Santa Clara (0-1), in a game counting for the second round of the I National Football League, after a solitary goal from Gonçalo Paciência. With this victory, the Azorean team provisionally joins Sporting at the top of the I Liga.

data.title: Alargamento do passe ferroviário em Lisboa e no Porto é "populista": há "problemas de oferta"
data.description: Fernando Nunes da Silva, especialista em transportes e antigo vereador, lamenta que o alargamento do passe ferroviário verde nas áreas metropolitanas de Lisboa e do Porto não seja acompanhado de um aumento de oferta. Receia ainda que haja impacto no Navegante e no Andante.
data.translatedTitle: Expansion of the rail pass in Lisbon and Porto is “populist”: there are “supply problems”
data.translatedDescription: Fernando Nunes da Silva, transport specialist and former councilor, regrets that the expansion of the green rail pass in the metropolitan areas of Lisbon and Porto is not accompanied by an increase in supply. He also fears that there will be an impact on Navegante and Andante.

data.title: 17h Autoridades falam do pior incêndio da história da Bélgica

data.title: II Liga. Benfica B vence em Leiria com duas grandes penalidades
data.description: Duas grandes penalidades convertidas por Gonçalo Moreira garantiram hoje a vitória (2-1) do Benfica B sobre a União de Leiria, em jogo da segunda jornada da II Liga de futebol disputado em Leiria.
data.translatedTitle: II League. Benfica B wins in Leiria with two penalties
data.translatedDescription: Two penalties converted by Gonçalo Moreira today guaranteed Benfica B's victory (2-1) over União de Leiria, in a game in the second round of the II Football League played in Leiria.

data.title: Ricardo Melo Gouveia cai para o 34.º lugar do Open da Dinamarca de golfe
data.description: O português Ricardo Melo Gouveia caiu hoje para o grupo dos golfistas classificados no 34.º lugar do Open da Dinamarca, após a conclusão da terceira volta do torneio do DP World Tour, liderado pelo francês Romain Langasque.
data.translatedTitle: Ricardo Melo Gouveia drops to 34th place in the Denmark Open
data.translatedDescription: Portuguese Ricardo Melo Gouveia today fell into the group of golfers ranked 34th at the Denmark Open, after the conclusion of the third round of the DP World Tour tournament, led by Frenchman Romain Langasque.

data.title: Colômbia. Número de mortos devido ao sismo subiu para 294
data.description: O número de mortos pelo sismo que atingiu a Colômbia na passada segunda-feira subiu para 294, mais seis do que na última contagem de sexta-feira, enquanto o número de desaparecidos aumentou para 320, segundo um boletim divulgado hoje pela Unidade Nacional de Gestão de Riscos de Desastres (UNGRD).
data.translatedTitle: Colombia. Death toll from earthquake rises to 294
data.translatedDescription: The number of deaths from the earthquake that hit Colombia last Monday rose to 294, six more than in the last count on Friday, while the number of missing people increased to 320, according to a bulletin released today by the National Disaster Risk Management Unit (UNGRD).

data.title: Incêndio na Bélgica já consumiu 1.650 hectares e ameaça casas em parque natural
data.description: O fogo de grandes dimensões em Les Gagnes está a progredir rapidamente num parque natural e a ameaçar habitações, tendo já ardido pelo menos 1.650 hectares.
data.translatedTitle: Fire in Belgium has already consumed 1,650 hectares and threatens homes in a natural park
data.translatedDescription: The huge fire in Les Gagnes is progressing quickly through a nature park and threatening homes, having already burned at least 1,650 hectares.

data.title: Europeus de atletismo. Pichardo e Nader tentam medalhas, Agate de Sousa a qualificação
data.description: Os campeões do mundo Pedro Pablo Pichardo, no triplo salto, e Isaac Nader, nos 1.500 metros, disputam hoje as respetivas finais nos Europeus de atletismo Birmingham2026, depois de Agate de Sousa enfrentar a qualificação no salto em comprimento.
data.translatedTitle: European athletics. Pichardo and Nader try for medals, Agate de Sousa the classification
data.translatedDescription: World champions Pedro Pablo Pichardo, in the triple jump, and Isaac Nader, in the 1,500 meters, compete today in their respective finals at the European Athletics Championships Birmingham2026, after Agate de Sousa faces classification in the long jump.

data.title: Europeus de atletismo. Vitória Oliveira bate recorde na meia maratona em marcha
data.description: A portuguesa Vitória Oliveira melhorou hoje em quatro minutos e meio o recorde nacional da meia maratona em marcha atlética, ao concluir a prova dos Europeus Birmingham2026 em 01:36.10 horas, no 13.º lugar.
data.translatedTitle: European athletics. Vitória Oliveira breaks record in walking half marathon
data.translatedDescription: The Portuguese Vitória Oliveira today improved the national record for the half marathon in race walking by four and a half minutes, completing the Birmingham2026 European race in 01:36.10 hours, in 13th place.

data.title: Atlético de Madrid contrata argentino Cristián Romero ao Tottenham
data.description: O defesa internacional argentino Cristián Romero transferiu-se do Tottenham para o Atlético de Madrid, tendo assinado um contrato de cinco temporadas com os espanhóis, até 2031, anunciaram hoje os dois clubes de futebol.
data.translatedTitle: Atlético de Madrid signs Argentine Cristián Romero from Tottenham
data.translatedDescription: Argentine international defender Cristián Romero transferred from Tottenham to Atlético de Madrid, having signed a five-year contract with the Spanish side, until 2031, the two football clubs announced today.

data.title: Avançado espanhol Ferran Torres troca FC Barcelona pelo PSG
data.description: O avançado Ferran Torres, autor do golo que consagrou a Espanha como campeã mundial de futebol, trocou o FC Barcelona pelo Paris Saint-Germain, assinando um contrato com os franceses até 2031, anunciaram hoje os dois clubes.
data.translatedTitle: Spanish striker Ferran Torres leaves FC Barcelona for PSG
data.translatedDescription: Striker Ferran Torres, scorer of the goal that made Spain world football champions, left FC Barcelona for Paris Saint-Germain, signing a contract with the French until 2031, the two clubs announced today.

data.title: Europeus de atletismo. Joana Pontes no top 10 da maratona em marcha com recorde nacional

data.title: Libya’s central bank chief resigns
data.description:
TRIPOLI: The governor of Libya’s central bank, Naji Issa, has resigned without giving a reason, several reports said on Monday.
	Private TV channel Al-Ahrar said Issa had confirmed his resignation.
	Issa and vice-governor Miree Al-Barasee were appointed by Libya’s parliament, which is based in the east of the divided country, in September 2024.
	His appointment was part of a deal backed by the United Nations that ended a standoff over Libya’s oil production and a deep financial crisis.

data.title: Trump insists Netanyahu relationship ‘very good’ despite Gaza rift
data.description:
WASHINGTON, United States: President Donald Trump insisted on Monday that his relationship with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is “very good” despite the Israeli leader’s rejection of a US-led Gaza plan.
	“The relationship is very good,” Trump said in response to a shouted question from a journalist at the end of an Oval Office event.
	After more than a week of gradually escalating criticism, Netanyahu explicitly stated on Sunday that he opposed the Gaza plan, which called for Israel to begin pulling back forces in tandem with disarmament by Hamas.

data.title: Final election phase begins in Pakistan-administered Kashmir despite banned group’s boycott call
data.description:
MUZAFFARABAD, Pakistan: Voters went to the polls Monday in the final phase of elections for the legislative assembly in Pakistan-administered Kashmir, following weeks of violent protests and clashes with security forces that overshadowed campaigning in the disputed Himalayan region, officials said.

	Men and women began lining up early at polling stations in Poonch district in the disputed Himalayan region, where four assembly seats were being contested.

data.title: Fire breaks out at Libya’s Zawiya refinery
data.description:
TRIPOLI: A fire broke out on Monday ​in a diesel tank at Libya’s Zawiya refinery days after the facility was hit by drone.

	The circumstances of Monday's fire remained unknown, Brega Petroleum Marketing Company said in a statement.
	Brega is owned by state oil firm National Oil Corporation (NOC) and is in charge of ‌fuel supplies.
	Zawiya refinery is the ‌largest in the ​country ‌while Ras ​Lanuf is out ⁠of operation and is located around 40 kilometers west of Tripoli.

data.title: Can Al-Burhan’s Sudanese national dialogue turn military gains into a political settlement?
data.description:

data.title: Ruyigi/Réfugiés congolais du camp de Busuma : « Qu’on nous laisse rentrer ! »
data.description: Le souhait des réfugiés congolais du camp de Busuma en commune Ruyigi, province Buhumuza est de pouvoir regagner leur patrie, ce vœu est sur toutes les lèvres. Ce vendredi 14 août une délégation de hautes personnalités dont le Chef de la diplomatie burundaise, le haut représentant de l’UA, le Groupe des diplomates africains, des humanitaires, … y a effectué une visite. Une occasion pour ces réfugiés de faire entendre leur calvaire et d’exprimer leur volonté de rentrer.
data.translatedTitle: Ruyigi/Congolese refugees from Busuma camp: “Let us go back!” »
data.translatedDescription: The wish of the Congolese refugees in the Busuma camp in Ruyigi commune, Buhumuza province is to be able to return to their homeland, this wish is on everyone's lips. This Friday, August 14, a delegation of senior personalities including the Head of Burundian diplomacy, the high representative of the AU, the Group of African diplomats, humanitarians, etc. paid a visit. An opportunity for these refugees to make their ordeal heard and to express their desire to return.

data.title: Nola : les tombes profanées poussent les familles à enterrer leurs morts chez elles
data.description: Fr : Sa : À Nola, dans la préfecture de la Sangha-Mbaéré, l’enterrement des cadavres à domicile prend de l’ampleur ces derniers temps. À l’origine de cette pratique, le manque de cimetières et la profanation des tombes par des ritualistes seraient notamment évoqués. Une situation qui n’est pas sans risques pour la santé et l’environnement. […] L’article Nola : les tombes profanées poussent les familles à enterrer leurs morts chez elles est apparu en premier sur Radio Ndeke Luka .
data.translatedTitle: Nola: desecrated graves push families to bury their dead at home
data.translatedDescription: Fr: Sa: In Nola, in the Sangha-Mbaéré prefecture, the burial of corpses at home is gaining momentum recently. At the origin of this practice, the lack of cemeteries and the desecration of graves by ritualists would be mentioned in particular. A situation which is not without risks for health and the environment. […] The article Nola: desecrated graves push families to bury their dead at home appeared first on Radio Ndeke Luka.

data.title: Mbuji-Mayi : les agents de la MIBA exigent le paiement de huit mois d’arriérés de salaire
data.description: Les agents et travailleurs de la Société minière de Bakwanga (MIBA) ont organisé, vendredi 14 aout 2026, un sit-in devant la barrière du polygone minier pour exiger le paiement de huit mois d’arriérés de salaire. data.title: Six voyageurs enlevés sur la route Kiwanja-Kanyabayonga au Nord-Kivu
data.description: Au moins six voyageurs n’ont pas atteint leur destination à Goma après avoir été enlevés, vendredi 14 aout 2026, par des hommes armés sur le tronçon Kiwanja-Kanyabayonga, dans le territoire de Rutshuru (Nord-Kivu). Selon des sources locales, la situation sécuritaire continue de se détériorer sur cette portion de la Route nationale n°2, actuellement sous contrôle de l’AFC/M23. Un enlèvement survenu à Mabenga
data.translatedTitle: Six travelers kidnapped on the Kiwanja-Kanyabayonga road in North Kivu
data.translatedDescription: At least six travelers did not reach their destination in Goma after being kidnapped, Friday August 14, 2026, by armed men on the Kiwanja-Kanyabayonga section, in the territory of Rutshuru (North Kivu). According to local sources, the security situation continues to deteriorate on this portion of National Road No. 2, currently under the control of the AFC/M23. A kidnapping that occurred in Mabenga

data.title: Kindu : exploitation des enfants à des fins commerciales par les parents pendant les vacances
data.description: À l’approche de la rentrée scolaire au Maniema, de nombreuses familles s’activent pour réunir les moyens nécessaires à l’achat des fournitures scolaires. Cependant, une utilisation abusive de nombreux enfants dans le petit commerce est observée dans la ville de Kindu.
data.translatedTitle: Kindu: exploitation of children for commercial purposes by parents during the holidays
data.translatedDescription: As the start of the school year approaches in Maniema, many families are working to raise the necessary means to purchase school supplies. However, the misuse of many children in small businesses is observed in the town of Kindu.

data.title: Félix Tshisekedi enjoint le Gouvernement à garantir « une rentrée scolaire 2026-2027 apaisée »
data.description: Le Président de la République, Félix Tshisekedi, a demandé au Gouvernement de tout mettre en œuvre pour assurer une rentrée scolaire 2026-2027 apaisée, effective et inclusive sur l’ensemble du territoire de la RDC. Cette instruction a été donnée lors du Conseil des ministres tenu le vendredi 14 août.
data.translatedTitle: Félix Tshisekedi urges the Government to guarantee “a peaceful 2026-2027 school year”
data.translatedDescription: The President of the Republic, Félix Tshisekedi, asked the Government to do everything possible to ensure a peaceful, effective and inclusive 2026-2027 school year across the entire territory of the DRC. This instruction was given during the Council of Ministers held on Friday August 14.

El hecho generó consternación entre las personas que se encontraban en las instalaciones. Tras lo ocurrido, la Gerencia de Deportes del Instituto Municipal de Deportes (Inmude) emitió una nota aclaratoria en la que expresó sus condolencias a los familiares y seres queridos del menor y detalló las circunstancias bajo las cuales, según la institución, se produjo el incidente. Inmude explicó que, al momento del hecho, las instalaciones estaban siendo utilizadas para desarrollar actividades del Programa de Olimpiadas Especiales, por lo que dicha actividad estaba bajo responsabilidad de ese programa. Según la versión proporcionada por la institución municipal, el menor habría ingresado al área de piscinas sin autorización y sin formar parte de la actividad que se desarrollaba en ese espacio. “Es importante aclarar que, al momento de suscitarse el incidente, las instalaciones se encontraban siendo utilizadas en el marco de las actividades del Programa de Olimpiadas Especiales”, señala el documento emitido por Inmude. La institución sostuvo que el ingreso del menor al área de piscinas no obedeció a una autorización, disposición o instrucción emitida por las autoridades de Inmude, sino que, según su información, se produjo de manera no autorizada. El lamentable hecho provocó una movilización en las instalaciones mientras se intentaba auxiliar al menor. Posteriormente se confirmó su fallecimiento por ahogamiento. La Municipalidad de San Pedro Sula, a través de Inmude, reiteró sus condolencias a la familia del menor y señaló que proporcionará la información requerida como parte de las investigaciones.
data.translatedTitle: Minor drowns in Patria Marathón pool; Municipality clarifies what happened
data.translatedDescription: A 13-year-old minor lost his life this Saturday after drowning in one of the pools at the Patria Marathón sports complex, in San Pedro Sula, northern Honduras. The victim was identified as José Levis Reyes Canales. According to preliminary information, the minor would have been stuck on the stairs of the pool, where he was later found without vital signs. The incident generated consternation among the people who were in the facilities. After what happened, the Sports Management of the Municipal Sports Institute (Inmude) issued an explanatory note in which it expressed its condolences to the family and loved ones of the minor and detailed the circumstances under which, according to the institution, the incident occurred. Inmude explained that, at the time of the incident, the facilities were being used to carry out activities of the Special Olympics Program, so said activity was under the responsibility of that program. According to the version provided by the municipal institution, the minor would have entered the swimming pool area without authorization and without being part of the activity that took place in that space. “It is important to clarify that, at the time of the incident, the facilities were being used within the framework of the activities of the Special Olympics Program,” states the document issued by Inmude. The institution maintained that the minor's entry into the pool area was not due to an authorization, provision or instruction issued by the Inmude authorities, but rather, according to its information, it occurred in an unauthorized manner. The unfortunate event caused a mobilization in the facilities while an attempt was made to help the minor. His death was later confirmed due to drowning. The Municipality of San Pedro Sula, through Inmude, reiterated its condolences to the minor's family and indicated that it will provide the required information as part of the investigations.
